sourceFreeze: Preparation intentionally does not create prepared_source_bindings.json. Root must finish all edits and tests, review the final source/helper/protocol bytes, then write the final bindings once. The parent refuses launch without that exact matching file. It freezes the binding record and all current common dependencies, all 17 preserved baseline files/receipt, prior seal/worker/synthetic evidence, helper, protocol and monitor through every child and completion.
comparison: Complete strict saved and reader JSON bytes, summary JSON bytes, CSV bytes including CRLF, and HTML bytes must equal. Compare in 64KiB binary reads; no exclusions. Same generated input hashes and independent all-frame gap/null/clock/role checks must equal. Any mismatch halts later cases.
baselinePath: Frozen preoptimization disk results/storage/document/reporting modules loaded in each old child under actual src.api.* aliases, storage first. Every imported DiskSeries/ResultStorage/file_hash class/function is asserted consistent. Both paths run build_result(_storage), publish_result, ResultDocument, presentation and streamed exports. No resident-list baseline replay or worker pipeline is run in this new experiment.
currentPath: Current four disk production modules under the same aliases and common bound dependencies. Candidate code changes are described by root final source review; preparation does not imply a latency improvement.
inputs: Streaming deterministic generated artifacts, no growing Python input list. Repeating camera-cut, missing selected box, malformed optional movement sample and source-transition gaps; null/empty/unknown/candidate people including fixed 67-person bursts; missing/occluded/detected/tracked/predicted/interpolated balls; measured zero movement; 65-frame pose prefix then missing observations; dense racket records with invalid locations; generated events/line calls withheld under authoritative=false. Synthetic attribution tests CSV formula and HTML escaping; it asserts neither a real asset nor actual rights.
timing: All timestamps equal index/60 by construction. String PTS endpoints and generated mapping file are preserved, explicitly marked synthetic; no decoded/native-camera/VFR timing evidence.
processOwnership: Verified OwnedProcessTree tracks only launched wrapper and discovered descendants by exact PID/createTime. Actual interpreter atomically publishes identity and waits <=10s for a sampled exact-identity acknowledgment before imports/work. Parent logs all per-process samples and aggregate RSS/private, and requires every remembered owned identity retired after normal or forced exit. Guard cleanup terminates only owned descendants deepest-first plus original Popen-handle fallback.
memoryMeaning: Windows child OS peak working set and peak process commit include startup/imports/input generation/production stages/verification. Samples aggregate exact owned tree; shared pages can be double-counted, 0.25s samples can miss peaks, host available RAM includes unrelated activity. Private bytes carry availability flags; Windows peak pagefile means peak process commit, not disk paging-file occupancy. Stage-boundary snapshots and timings are descriptive, not separately reset OS peaks.
readTimingMeaning: Both paths separately time construction, publication, reader open, presentation, streamed JSON, CSV, HTML and independent checks. Reader-open follows its bound production hash validation/cache; each export times first chunk, all chunks written/closed and its separate full-output verification hash. Full export stages include that verification cost.
diskMeaning: Logical file sizes only, including raw inputs, compatibility JSON, database, exports and SQLite sidecars at boundaries; no claim about physical allocated blocks or device write amplification.
retention: Exclusively create run and every case; refuse reused output. Preserve all receipts/logs/partial inputs/databases/exports on any failure. Halt all later cases on comparison, child, source-binding, retirement or resource failure. Never overwrite historical receipts, original media, production job state or public demo files.
limitations: No inference, model import, training, FFmpeg, video decoding or footage is requested.
No 432000 case, full-video memory claim, full-match capacity or scientific accuracy qualification.
One old/new run at each count; no variance estimate or stable throughput qualification.
Pose is intentionally a short prefix; successful measurements do not cover dense pose for a full match.
The browser still materializes complete result arrays; this unit measures server construction/publication/read/export only.
Failures remain failures; smaller success does not relabel a larger unstarted or failed case.
historicalEvidencePreserved: Earlier resident-list versus disk comparison, its initially failed timestamp auditor and corrected terminal audit, actual worker smoke, and the completed result-storage seal are retained and hash-bound. This is a separate preoptimization-disk versus current-disk comparison; prior receipts are not rewritten or rerun.
latencyInterpretation: One old/new observation per count; report raw stage/child/monitor times separately. No variance estimate, throughput target or performance qualification gate is implied by exact-output success.
